WITNESSETH:
WHEREAS, Lessor owns the real property and buildings located at 255 Storey Blvd,
Cheyenne, WY 82009 which may hereinafter be called the"Property."
WHEREAS, Lessor desires to lease the Premises known an individual office in the
Property on the terms and conditions hereinafter set forth.
NOW, THEREFORE, it is mutually agreed between the parties hereto as follows:
1.DEMISE AND TERM: Lessor hereby leases to Lessee, and Lessee hereby rents
from Lessor, the property for a term of 3year(s) commencing on January 1,2025.The Premises
shall consist of200squarefoot office in the building and associated parking located at255
Storey Blvd, Cheyenne, WY82009.

starting on January 1, 2025:
Monthly Rent:$250.00/month

hereof beginning with the month of January1,2025.Any payment received more than10 days
after the due date shall have added thereto a late payment penalty equal to10%of the payment.
Lessee shall not be obligated topaya damage and security deposit
3.QUIET ENJOYMENT: Lessor warrants that it is the owner of the Premises and
hasfull right and authority to enterinto this Lease.Lessor covenants that, forand during the
term of this Lease, it will not cause or allow anything tobe done whichwill impair Lessee's
leasehold interest andrights hereunder.Lessor shall defend the Lesseein the enjoyment and
peaceful possession of the premises during all terms of this lease.
4.UTILITIES AND OTHER EXPENSES: Lessor shall be responsible for all
carrying costsfor the property which shall include: outside maintenance, landscaping of the
Lessor shallpay thereal estatetaxes, andstandard property insurance associated with the
Property.Lessee shall be exclusively responsible for business insurance, personal property tax,
indoor maintenance, windows, internet and telephone of theleased Premises.
5.REPAIR AND MAINTENANCE: Lessor shall, at its expense, keep andmaintain
the Premises in a clean, neat, sanitary order and in good condition and repair during the
occupancy of Lessee.Lessee shall not cause or permit any waste or nuisance in orabout the
Premises.Lessee is responsible for all routine repairs other than normalwear and tear, including
brokenglass, damage to interior walls, doors and fixtures.Any major repairs shall beprimarily
the responsibility of the Lessor.

access to the Premises at all reasonable times for the purpose of inspecting the same and to make

any changes or alterations itmay consider appropriate for the protection of thebuilding or to
render it and its appurtenances safe.

behalf of Lessee, which may cloud or impair Lessor's title to the leased Premises; and that if any

at its own expense.

sustained on or about the Premises arising from any event, except anyloss, damage or injury that
is directly caused by the negligent act of Lessor, Lessor's agent, or Lessor's employees.

of the Premises required tomeet its specific needs.Any improvements/alterations desired by
Lessee shall be submitted inwriting toand approved inwritingby the Lessor before anywork
maybegin.essee shall not make any alterations to the Premises, orany part thereof, without
the consent of the Lessor.Any addition to, or alterations of, the Premises shall become part of
the realty and belong to the Lessor; provided that nothing herein shall affect the Lessee's rights
with respect to trade fixtures and other movable property belonging to Lessee.Lessee shall, at its
expense, repair any damage caused to the Premises by the removal of its personal property.

unrepaired. Lessor shall promptly proceed to repair the damage due to such casualty.If such
damage cannot be repaired within 30 daysfrom the date of damage because of its extent or the

events beyond the control of Lessor, Lessor shall promptly notify Lessee in writing of suchfact
and Lessee shall then have the option to terminate this Lease forthwith.If Lessee notifies Lessor
that he does not elect to exercise this option to terminate, Lessor shall arrange and proceed to
repairsuch damage assoon as reasonably possible.

ORDER ALLOWING SALE OF PERSONAL PROPERTY
Leslee K.Gallion and Marsha K.Dibble, Co-Administrators of the Estate of Leslie W.
Gallion, deceased, having brought the Petition for the Sale of Personal Property, and due proof
having been made of the allegations therein, and the law and the evidence fully considered:
IT IS ADJUDGED AND DECREED that the said LeslieW.Galli on died on the July16,
2024, intestate, in Laramie County, Wyoming; that said decedent resided in Laramie County,
Wyoming when he died; and that said decedent left an estate in Laramie County, Wyoming, and
within the jurisdiction of this Court.
IT IS ORDERED that the personal property in the estate, consisting of 20,000 shares of
F&G Corporation stock, may be sold according to the terms of and for the amounts identified in
the Stock Purchase Agreement governing the same.The Co-Administrators have authority to
execute any and all necessary documents to effectuate performance of the terms of the Stock
Purchase Agreement.
